engine_axes.note: Unity axes; the Blender scripts model in X right, Y forward, Z up and the FBX export maps Y->+Z, Z->+Y

pivot: ground plane under the body centre (same as RaceCar.prefab: wheel centres at y=0.34)

wheels.child: each Wheel_XX pivot has exactly one child Wheel_XX_Spinner (CarController spins GetChild(0) about local X, steers the pivot about local Y)

turret.rule: CarCannon.barrel and CarCannon.muzzle are pre-assigned, so CarCannon.BuildTurret never runs (no duplicate barrel)

materials.M_HunyuanSample_CarPaint: body: vertex colour rgb; alpha 1 = paint (tinted by _BaseColor via CarPaint), 0 = fixed trim colour, 0.5 = fixed + emissive (lights)
materials.M_HunyuanSample_Trim: wheels and barrel: plain vertex colour, never tinted by paint

shading: flat (split normals per face at export)
